# KASKUS

> KASKUS is Indonesia's largest community forum platform for sharing hobbies, gaming discussions, and marketplace interactions.

KASKUS serves as a multi-category social platform where Indonesian users engage in discussions ranging from gaming and esports (particularly Mobile Legends and competitive tournaments like M1 World Championship) to general hobby communities. The platform emphasizes user-generated content and community-driven conversations across diverse interest groups.

## Key Topics

- Community Forum
- Indonesian Social Network
- Mobile Legends
- Gaming & Esports
- EVOS Legends
- User-Generated Content
- Discussion Platform
- Hobby Communities
- Thread Submission
- Multi-Category Forum
- M1 World Championship
- MPL Indonesia
- Social Media
- Community Platform
- Indonesian Culture

## Core Platform

- [KASKUS Homepage](https://www.kaskus.co.id): Main community forum hub for Indonesian users to share hobbies, discuss gaming, and engage in marketplace activities.
- [Create New Post](https://www.kaskus.co.id/quicknewthread): Post creation interface for submitting new threads and discussions to the KASKUS community forum.

## Gaming & Esports Discussions

- [EVOS Legends: Indonesia's Mobile Legends Pride](https://www.kaskus.co.id/thread/69baa9ecac637c018e080ace/evos-legends-kebanggaan-indonesia-dalam-sejarah-mobile-legends): Community discussion on EVOS Legends' historic victory at the Mobile Legends M1 World Championship.

## News & Announcements

- [Government Announcement: Eid al-Fitr 1447 H Date](https://www.kaskus.co.id/thread/69bbfe685b14680cc10e9c7b/pemerintah-tetapkan-1-syawal-1447-h-bertepatan-21-maret-2026): Forum post discussing the Indonesian government's official announcement of Eid al-Fitr 1447 H celebration date.
